## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences on what this PR changes and why. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — user-visible feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] chore — tooling / build / dependency change
- [ ] test — test-only change
- [ ] refactor — neither a feature nor a fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes (`npm run format` to auto-fix)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] If a new tool was added: README tools table updated, `TOOL_NAMES` updated, CHANGELOG entry added.
- [ ] No secrets, real API keys, or production data in the diff.
